svg.title: Restart, Summarise or Persist
svg.desc: A chat timeline: decisions made early get mixed up a hundred messages later, so you ask for a summary and start a new chat from it, and save anything every chat needs to Project knowledge; for one sensitive chat, use incognito outside a Project or turn memory off inside one.
svg.text: Chats are temporary; save what you'll need again.
Not in history or memory; kept 30 days
